name: Wison
description: Shanghai group in two relevant businesses: Wison Engineering Services (HK-listed; EPC and technology for ethylene, coal-to-chemicals and other petrochemical plants) and Wison New Energies (EPCIC for floating LNG, FPSOs, modularised onshore LNG plants and floating wind, from one of the world's largest floating-facility fabrication yards in Nantong). Recent work: signed Baleine Phase 3 FPSO EPCIC contract, Tango FLNG, S188 FSRU, China's first floating wind project, selection for pre-FEED/EPC of two 3-MTPA FLNGs in Nigeria (Jan 2024), and a DMR FLNG technology collaboration licensed from Shell Catalysts & Technologies.

sources.note: Group site and 2025 interim report coverage, verified via web search 2026-10-29
